versions.short: The proposal would set common EU rules for adults who cannot fully look after their own interests, covering which country's courts can take protective measures, which law applies, and how such measures and powers of representation are recognised and enforced across Member States. It would also create a European Certificate of Support and Representation so that representatives can prove their powers abroad, set up cooperation between national courts and Central Authorities, and provide for electronic communication between them. The main areas addressed are jurisdiction, applicable law, recognition and enforcement, the certificate, cooperation, and digital communication.
